questions: Where exactly is the pain located (e.g., chest, throat, ear, sinus/face, head), and does it radiate anywhere?
Are you having shortness of breath, sweating, nausea/vomiting, or lightheadedness along with the chest/epigastric pain?
answers: It’s in the lower chest, the right side of the chest, both breasts (right and left), and the epigastric area. It radiates to both biceps, the thyroid cartilage, the thoracic spine, and the right shoulder.
